name: MonarchCard
title: Card
summary: A padded surface with a hairline border and rounded corners. It has no shadow by default; a shadow from the theme's elevation tokens is for a card that floats above the page.
whenToUse: To group related content on a canvas.
whenNotToUse: Inside a List or Form, use the system's grouped rows. Do not nest cards.
api: init(elevation: MonarchElevationLevel = .none, padding: MonarchCardPadding = .standard, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content)
init<Footer: View>(elevation: MonarchElevationLevel = .none, padding: MonarchCardPadding = .standard, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content, @ViewBuilder footer: () -> Footer)

options.name: elevation
options.description: none (the default: a hairline border on the surface), or xs, sm, md, lg, xl for a card that floats above the page.

options.name: padding
options.description: .flush for content that runs to the edges (a list, an image); the card clips it to its corners.

options.name: footer
options.description: Actions or a note under the content, after a divider, with the standard padding.

options.name: content
options.description: Laid out in a leading-aligned vertical stack.

appearance: Surface colour with a subtle border and 12-point corners, flat by default as an inline surface should be. When given an elevation, the shadows come from the theme, so they are darker in the dark themes.
platformNotes: Android wraps Material 3 Surface. The token's shadow spread is not drawn, because SwiftUI shadows have no spread. The card has no pressed state; make it tappable by putting it in a Button or NavigationLink.
accessibility: The card is an accessibility container; its children stay separate elements in reading order.
The card adds no touch behaviour.
edgeCases: The card fills the available width.
Content sets its own text colours.
